Commentary.Commentary: We are back for the chase. India make their way out in the middle followed by the Sri Lankan openers. Nuwanidu Fernando and Avishka Fernando will be the openers for Sri Lanka. Mohammad Shami will start the proceedings with the first new ball for India. Also, Dunith Wellalage has been approved as the concussion substitute for Jeffrey Vandersay.
... THE RUN CHASE ...

Right then, India would certainly be the happier side at the halfway mark and they look set to clinch the series 3-0. On the other hand, Sri Lanka have their backs against the wall and they will need to bat out of their skins if they are to avoid a whitewash. Will the Lankan batters stand up to the challenge? We will find out shortly. Back in a bit for the chase...

Despite starting well with the ball in the first four overs, Sri Lanka lost the plot when Lahiru Kumara was smashed all around the park in the 6th over. The visitors kept bowling loose deliveries and that allowed the hosts to score freely throughout the innings. Even the spinners failed to keep the runs in check and it was a disappointing bowling display by the visitors. Ashen Bandara and Jeffrey Vandersay collided with each other near the ropes to make matters worse for the visitors. Wanindu Hasaranga was their most economical bowler on the day but he went wicketless. Kasun Rajitha and Lahiru Kumara accounted for two wickets each while Chamika Karunaratne took one wicket.

India finish on a high and end up with a mammoth total on the board. Having chosen to bat first, India were off to a sedate start courtesy of their openers Rohit Sharma and Shubman Gill. However, once the duo got to terms with the pace and bounce of the wicket, India started to motor along. The hosts never looked back and continued to play their shots for the rest of the innings. Shubman Gill and Virat Kohli notched up their respective hundreds with the latter staying unbeaten on 166 runs to get India to the 390-run mark.
FOUR! 10 runs off the last two deliveries. It is full, wide outside off. Virat Kohli steers it through the gap at point. The ball races away to the boundary. India ends their innings at 390/5.
SIX! Virat Kohli is not stopping at all. Back of a length, outside off. Virat Kohli swivels and smokes it over the mid-wicket fence. It was six from the moment he hit it.
Very full, on off. Patel smacks it down to long off for one more.
Virat Kohli drives this full ball into covers for a single.
Length, outside off. Kohli tries to chase it but misses.

SIX! Avishka Fernando tries hard to save the boundary here but has his foot grounded beyond the ropes here. It is a short ball, on off. Virat Kohli dances down the track and pulls it to deep mid-wicket. Avishka Fernando leaps near the ropes and tosses the ball back in play. The replays confirm that it is a maximum and Virat Kohli moves to 155. An excellent innings from him, followed by a short celebration.
Lahiru Kumara will bowl the final over.
Kasun Rajitha fires in a yorker, on off. Virat Kohli digs it out to point and crosses for one. He moves to 149.
Very full, attacking the off pole. Axar Patel gets his blade down in time and drills it down to long on for a single.
Axar Patel is the new man in.

OUT! CAUGHT! Suryakumar Yadav tries to break his shackles but holes out instead. It is full, wide outside off. Suryakumar Yadav tries to go inside-out but get it off the outside edge. Avishka Fernando settels under it in the deep and takes a sharp catch. Kasun Rajitha gets his second wicket of the innings.
Commentary.Howout: c Avishka Fernando b Kasun Rajitha

Commentary.Commentary: Fuller, wide of off. Kohli drives it through covers for a single.

DROPPED! It is full, outside off. Suryakumar Yadav reverse-sweeps it towards short third man. The fielder there leaps to his right but is unable to grab it safely. He gets a second opportunity but misses out this time as well. One taken.
It is a full-length ball, outside off. Suryakumar Yadav lofts it to the right of sweeper cover. They comes back for two runs.
WIDE! Kasun Rajitha goes full, wide outside off. In fact, it moves past the tramline. Suryakumar Yadav tries to chase it but misses. Wide called.
Lahiru Kumara goes full, outside leg. Suryakumar Yadav paddles it towards short fine but it lands in between the two fielders. They take a single.
Suryakumar Yadav walks out to bat.

OUT! CAUGHT! Lahiru Kumara gets his second wicket. KL Rahul goes back for just 7 runs. It is a short ball, wide outside off. KL Rahul stays back and goes for the cut shot. The ball takes the outside edge and flies straight down the throat of Dunith Wellalage in the deep, who makes no mistake.
Commentary.Howout: c sub Dunith Wellalage b Lahiru Kumara

Commentary.Commentary: Virat Kohli smacks this short ball down the ground for a single.
This is overpitched, just outside off. KL Rahul gets under it and chips it towards mid on. Dasun Shanaka there leaps, gets both hands on it but it spills out of the hands. One taken.
LEG BYE! Full and on the pads. Kohli misses his flick. It goes to square leg off the pads. They cross for a leg bye.
FOUR! Virat Kohli is on a roll here. Lahiru Kumara tries to go for the yorker but it comes out as a full toss, on middle and leg. Virat Kohli stays back and whips it over square leg. Four runs.
An inswinger, full and on off. Kohli drives it down the ground for another single. He moves to 142 off just 100 balls.
Full length, on fifth stump. KL Rahul stands tall and tries to whip it down the ground. The ball goes to the left of the keeper off the inside edge. One taken.
WIDE! Slower one, length ball, wide outside off. It shapes outside the tramline. Wided.
FOUR! KL Rahul now joins the party. It is a full toss, outside off. KL Rahul smacks it through the gap at covers. It races away to the boundary.
Kasun Rajitha dishes it full, wide outside off. Kohli guides it through cover-point. One taken.
SIX! What an excellent shot. It flies over the ropes. It is overpitched, just outside off. It is in the arc of Kohli and he dispatches it over the bowler's head for another biggie.
WIDE! This is full, spilled way outside the tramline. Kohli lets it be. Wide called. Kasun Rajitha has to reload this delivery.
SIX! BANG! Virat Kohli is eyeing ihis 150 here. He is just 16 runs short now. Good length, on middle and leg. Virat Kohli clears his front leg and smokes it over the wide long on fence for a maximum.
A dot to end the over! It is a length ball, on off. KL Rahul blocks it to mid off. Just four runs and a wicket off it.
Length, on middle and leg. Kohli whips it to deep mid-wicket and crosses for one.
KL Rahul gets off the mark instantly. It is full, wide outside off. KL Rahul steps across and drives it through point for a single.
KL Rahul comes out to bat at number 5.

OUT! CAUGHT! Shreyas Iyer tries to go over the infield but holes out instead. It is a length ball, outside off. Shreyas Iyer stands tall and looks to drive it uppishly through the off side. He miscues his shot though as the bottom hand comes off the blade. Dhananjaya de Silva, the substitute fielder takes a dolly at extra cover.
Commentary.Howout: c sub Dhananjaya de Silva b Lahiru Kumara

Commentary.Commentary: Length ball, angled into the pads. Kohli stays back and clips it past mid on for a single.
It is full, sliding down leg. Iyer gets it to fine leg with a tickle. They cross for one.
Slower and fuller outside off, Virat Kohli gets down and slogs this one wide of long on and collects a couple of runs.
FOUR! Stunning shot! Back of a length around off, Virat Kohli stays still and just punches this one over extra cover. Gets it well wide of deep cover and collects a boundary.
A pacy delivery, short and on off, Virat Kohli tries to ramp this one over the keeper's head but fails to get any bat on it.

SIX! TWO IN TWO! Slower and into the wicket on middle by Chamika Karunaratne, Virat Kohli picks the change of pace and pulls this one with disdain. It goes all the way towards the mid-wicket fence for a maximum.
SIX! Full and just outside off, at 132.4 kph, Virat Kohli stays deep in the crease and lets the bat flow. Plays this one with a straight bat and clears the long off fence for a maximum.
Short and on middle, Shreyas Iyer stands tall and pulls it to deep square leg for a run.
Slower and on a length on off, Shreyas Iyer pulls this one down to long on for a single.
Full and at the stumps, Virat Kohli clips this one along the ground to deep mid-wicket for a run.

SIX! SHOT! Slower and fuller on off, right in the slot for the batter, Virat Kohli goes down the track and thrashes this one down the ground. Clears the long on fence with ease and collects a maxmimum.
Full and outside off, Virat Kohli drives firmly but straight to cover.
Kasun Rajitha sees the batter shuffle across to scoop and bowls it slower and fuller on off near the tramline, Shreyas Iyer changes his mind at the last moment and works it to point for a run.
Slower and on a length outside off, Virat Kohli slaps this one down to long off and takes a single.

HUNDRED for Virat Kohli! Chamika Karunaratne bowls this one on a length around off, Virat Kohli gets to the pitch of the delivery and leans into the drive. Knocks it towards long on and collects a single to bring up hundred number 46 of his ODI career. Virat Kohli gets his third century in the last four matches. The king is back to his best.

Play halted! Two fielders collide in the deep and the physio rushes out on the field to have a look. Both the players in pain near the ropes. It is Ashen Bandara that slides into Jeffrey Vandersay. It is not looking good as a stretcher is being called out now. Jeffrey Vandersay is somewhat on his feet here, while Bandara remains on the ground. Well, it is not a great sign, as another stretcher is being called out as well. The injured players are being taken off here. The umpire asks the Sri Lankan players to take the field. The focus back on Kohli now, who is on 99.

FOUR! Virat Kohli moves to 99! Short and on middle, Virat Kohli picks the length early and pulls this one off the front foot. Hits it right between deep square leg and deep mid-wicket, Ashen Bandara and Jeffrey Vandersay run around from their respective positions to prevent the boundary but end up colliding with each other. The ball deflects off their feet and trickles into the boundary.
Slower and into the wicket outside off, the ball does not bounce as expected but Shreyas Iyer still manages to swat this one towards deep mid-wicket for a run.
Back of a length on off, Virat Kohli punches this one off the back foot to deep point for a single. Kohli moves to 95.
Full and angling at the pads, Shreyas Iyer works this one to the right of deep backward square leg. Jeffrey Vandersay runs around and keeps it to one.
FOUR! Chamika Karunaratne bowls a cutter, full and around off, Shreyas Iyer waits for it and goes down the ground. Hits it uppishly but to the left of long on and collects a boundary.
Short and outside off, Shreyas Iyer pushes this one from the crease towards deep cover for a run.
Fullish delivery at the pads from wide of the crease, Virat Kohli flicks this one to deep mid-wicket for a run.
Short and on off, Virat Kohli pushes this one off the back foot straight to cover.
Drifting into the pads, Shreyas Iyer slogs this one towards deep mid-wicket and takes a single.
Short and around off, Shreyas Iyer picks the length early and rocks back in the crease. Punches this one to the right of deep cover and collects a brace.
Tad short and outside off, Shreyas Iyer cuts hard but straight to backward point for a dot.
Another yorker around off, Virat Kohli digs this one out towards deep mid-wicket. Nuwanidu Fernando there charges towards the ball and fumbles which allows Kohli to come back for the second.
Cutter, full and down the leg side, Shreyas Iyer turns this down to fine leg for a single.
Full and in the channel outside off, Shreyas Iyer drives this one straight to cover.
Yorker on middle, Virat Kohli squeezes this one out towards deep square leg for a single.
Back of a length on middle, Virat Kohli taps this one gently towards mid-wicket and that allows him to collect a brace there.

SIX! JUST OVER! Lahiru Kumara bowls this one full and at the stumps, Virat Kohli gets down the track to go down the ground but gets this on from the inner part of the bat. Jeffrey Vandersay at long on is off the ropes and he misjudges the flight of the delivery. The ball sails over his head for a maximum.
Time for Powerplay 3! Sri Lanka can now have a maximum of 5 fielders outside the 30-yard circle.
Hasaranga goes full and on off. Kohli once again goes down the ground and crosses.
Flighted and full, on middle. Iyer knocks it down the ground for one.
On leg, Kohli drives it past mid on for a single.
FOUR! Good use of the feet here. Kohli moves to 80 now. It is floated and full, around off. Kohli dances down the track and drills it down to long on for four runs.
This is clipped to the leg side for one.
Overthorws! It is full and on off. Iyer works it down to long on. They take one. There is an overthrow which allows the batters to sneak another run.
Length, on middle and leg. Iyer shuffles and tucks it towards mid on. They take one run.
Touch short, outside off. Iyer tries to chase it but misses and conncets with thin air.
Virat Kohli now flicks this full ball towards mid-wicket and takes one.
An in-tucker, full and on middle. Iyer shuffles and nudges it to the leg side for a single.
Full and at the stumps. defended.
LEG BYE! It is a length ball, drifting down leg. It goes to fine leg off the thigh pads. Kohli crosses for a leg bye.
On a length, straying on the pads. Virat Kohli hangs back and clips it to square on the leg side for a single. He moves to 75.
Shreyas Iyer uses his feet and tucks this full delivery towards mid on.
Virat Kohli nudges this full ball to mid-wicket for one.
On off, defended.
Flatter and on leg. Iyer goes back and works it down to long on for one.
SIX! BANG! Shreyas Iyer puts the pressure on Wanindu Hasaranga. It is tossed up, full and outside off. Shreyas Iyer gets down on one knee and tonks it over the mid-wicket fence.
An inswinging full delivery, on middle. Iyer drives it down to mid on and crosses. He retains the strike. Also, 250 is up for the hosts.
Shreyas Iyer is struggling to time his shot. Back of a length, outside off. Iyer goes for the cut but inside-edges it on to the deck.
Good length, in the channel. Iyer tries to pull it away but gets an inside edge on his pads.

FOUR! Shreyas Iyer gets fortunate here but will take it however they come. It is a short ball, on middle. It hurries onto the batter. This one does not bounce as much. Iyer tries to heave it across the line but gets a top-edge on it. The ball flies over the keeper's head for a boundary.
Virat Kohli pulls this short ball straight to the man at deep square one and rotates the strike.
Chamika Karunaratne bangs in a short one, on off. Shreyas Iyer drags his short ball to deep square leg. They take a single.
A length ball, outside off. Iyer guides it to the right of third man. They take a single. 8 runs off the over.
This is straying on the pads. Kohli nudges it to the leg side for one. Kohli wanted the second one as well but Shreyas Iyer denies.
Length, outside off. Kohli defends it to mid off.
Kasun Rajitha serves a length ball, just outside off, it nips in a touch. Shreyas Iyer dabs it out to cover-point and takes a single.
Kasun Rajitha goes full, outside off. Virat Kohli steps outside the crease and steers it through the cover region for one.
FOUR! Nicely played! Kasun Rajitha bowls a loosener, drifting down leg. Virat Kohli hangs back and flicks it behind square on the leg side for a boundary. He races away to 70 runs now.

Fuller, on middle and leg. Kohli nudges it through mid-wicket and crosses. Seven runs off the over. The loss of wicket has hardly bothered India here. Sri Lanka need a couple more in quick succession.
Make it three now! Much fuller, outside off. Kohli latches onto it and drives it to the man at covers.
Consecutive dots now! A slower ball bumper, outside off. Virat Kohli watches it sail past him.
Length, on fifth stump. Kohli gets it to cover off the outside edge.
Good length, on the pads, hurried on the batter. Kohli short-arm jabs it through mid-wicket for a brace.

FOUR! Virat Kohli continues on his merry way! It is a slower one, wide outside off, just short of a good length. It gives enough time for Kohli to think and he crunches it through the gap at covers for a cracking boundary.

Kasun Rajitha serves it on a length, on the pads. Kohli tucks it to mid-wicket and gets a single. A successful over by Kasun Rajitha comes to an end. Can Sri Lanka put some pressure on the new batter here?
Short, on middle and leg. Iyer pulls it to the leg side and crosses. One taken. He gets off the mark instantly.
Shreyas Iyer is the new man in.

OUT! BOWLED! Kasun Rajitha strikes and gets rid of Gill. A wonderful innings comes to an end. It is an off-cutter, on off. Gill dances down the track and looks to heave it down the ground but gets beaten by the uneven bounce. The ball stays very low than what Gill anticipated, to go onto crash into the stumps. A much-needed wicket for Sri Lanka.
Full, attacking the pads. Kohli flicks it through mid-wicket for a single.
Back of a length, on off. Kohli pulls it to the right of mid on off the toe end. Wanindu Hasaranga is quick to get to his left and stop the ball.
Shubman Gill stays back to this good-length delivery and flicks it to square leg off his hips. They take one.

Time for Drinks! India continue to press on the accelerator with Shubman Gill and Virat Kohli in the middle. The hosts look set for a mammoth total with plenty of batting still to come. With still 17 overs remaining in the innings, these are ominous signs for Sri Lanka and the visitors need a wicket soon to stem the flow of runs. They now bring Kasun Rajitha back into the attack in search of some wickets.
Shubman Gill now retains the strike by taking a single off the final delivery. Chamika Karunaratne goes full, on the pads. Gill flicks it through the gap at mid-wicket and crosses.
Back of a length, outside off. Virat Kohli rides the bounce and pulls it through mid-wicket along the ground. One taken.
Virat Kohli taps this full ball back to the bowler. So, Chamika Karunaratne has been able to restrict the boundaries in this over.
A short ball, outside off, around 129 clicks. Virat Kohli tries to heave it across the line but only manages to get a glove on it.
Shubman Gill now rotates the strike. It is fuller, on off stump. Shubman Gill works it to mid off with soft hands. The fielder there fumbles which allows the batters to take a single quite easily.
Kohli punches this length ball to point and takes a single.
Chamika Karunaratne (3-0-9-1) is back on.

FOUR! Fourth boundary of the over and Jeffrey Vandersay has now conceded 59 runs in 7 overs. It is short, angled down leg. Gill goes back and pulls it over mid-wicket. A couple of bounces over the ropes.
Shorter, on leg. Kohli goes back inside his crease and flicks it through mid-wicket for one run.
FOUR! Virat Kohli now getting into the act. It is overpitched, on off. Virat Kohli leans forward and creams it past the bowler, down to long off for a cracking boundary.
Flatter and on middle. Gill goes back and tucks it to mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR! Jeffrey Vandersay overcompensates this time. A full toss, outside off. Shubman Gill crunches it through covers. The man in the deep dives to his right but in vain.
FOUR! SHOT! It is a short ball, on off. Gill swivels and heaves it across the line over mid-wicket for four runs. He is taking the charge here.

GILL GETS HIS TON! His second in ODIs. It is full and on off. Gill uses his feet and pushes it down to long on for one run. He fist bumps Kohli on the way to the other end. He raises his bat and soaks himself in the applauds. A fick knock by the youngster.
FIFTY for Kohli! An incredible innings by the veteran. It is on leg, Kohli tucks it to the leg side and take a single.

FOUR! EDGY! 200 is up for India. Virat Kohli one shot of his half-ton and Gill at the other end is one run away from his century. It is tossed up, around off. Kohli gets an outside edge. It runs down to third man for four runs.
This is full, straying on the pads. Gill nudges it to square leg and crosses. The stand moves to 100.
Floated and full, on off. Kohli comes down the track and knocks it to long on for one.
Shubman Gill moves to 98! It is short, angled across, Gill goes back and cuts it through point for a single.
Low full toss on middle, Shubman Gill flicks this one wide of long on and collects a single.
Fullish delivery outside off, Virat Kohli presses forward and drives it to long off for a run.
Short and on middle, Shubman Gill punches it down to long on for a single.
Short and at the stumps, Virat Kohli whips this one down to long on for a single.
Short and outside off, Shubman Gill cuts it firmly towards deep cover. The initial call was for two but has to settle for a single.
Short and around off, Virat Kohli rocks back and pulls this one towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
SIX! Nuwanidu Fernando floats this one, full and outside off, Shubman Gill does not miss out this time, frees his arms and thumps this one towards the long off fence for a maximum.

FOUR! Streaky but Shubman Gill will take it! Slower and tad short on off, Shubman Gill shimmies down the track to go down the ground but gets a thick outside edge that goes to the left of short third man for a boundary.
Fuller and on off, Virat Kohli presses forward and knocks it down to long onf for a single.
Short and turning at the pads, the ball keeps a bit low but Gill manages to push it in front of deep square leg for a run.
Short and turning in on off, Virat Kohli goes back and nudges this one to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Short and outside off by Nuwanidu Fernando, Virat Kohli whips this one off the back foot straight to mid-wicket.
Change. Nuwanidu Fernando comes into the attack now.
Fuller and on middle, Virat Kohli knocks this one down to long on for a single.
Short and outside off, Shubman Gill cuts this one firmly towards deep cover for a run.
Wanindu Hasaranga bowls this one with a low trajectory, short and outside off, Virat Kohli slaps this one down to long off for a single.
Fuller and on off, Shubman Gill drives it down to long on for a single.
Floated, fullish on off, Virat Kohli drives this one to the right of the bowler and takes a single.
Short and turning away on middle, Shubman Gill pulls this one to deep square leg for a run.
Back of a length on off, Shubman Gill whips this one to the right of long on and collects a single.
Full and at the pads by Dasun Shanaka, Shubman Gill drives this one along the carpet, hits it wide of long and that allows Gill to come back for the second.
Fullish delivery at the pads, Virat Kohli flicks this one to deep mid-wicket for a run.
Fuller and on off, Shubman Gill presents a full face of the bat and drives it towards mid on. Kasun Rajitha dives to his left and keeps it to one.
On a length on off, Virat Kohli shimmies down the track to go inside out but mishits this one towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Play halted! Virat Kohli wants a change in helmet here, this also gives a chance to the players to get a breather here.
Lenght delivery outside off, Shubman Gill uses his feet and pushes it firmly towards mid off. Collects a quick single. The batters decide not to run on the overthrow and settle for a single.
Full and on middle, Virat Kohli pushes it to the right of the bowler but Wanindu Hasaranga dives to his right and stops it.
Full and outside off, Virat Kohli drives it straight to cover.
Short and quicker on middle, Shubman Gill plays this one towards square leg for a run.
Fuller and on middle, Virat Kohli drives this one off the front foot down to long on for a single.
Full and at the stumps, Shubman Gill uses his feet and drives it to long on for a run
Short and drifting in on leg, Shubman Gill goes back and pushes it towards mid-wicket, Dasun Shanaka sprints to his left and makes a good stop.
On off, driven to covers.
Slower one, outside off. Virat Kohli looks to chase it but misses.
A length ball, wide of off. Kohli looks to chase it but misses.
On a length and outside off, Virat Kohli tries to carve this one on the off side but the ball keeps a bit low and he misses.
On the pads, flicked to the leg side for a single.
FOUR! Short and outside off by Dasun Shanaka, Shubman Gill advances down the track and gets on top of the bounce, swats this one wide of long on for a boundary.
Tossed up nicely, full and on middle, Virat Kohli works this one straight to mid-wicket.
Full and on middle, nudged to the leg side.

LBW not given and Sri Lanka review. Short and drifting at the pads by Wanindu Hasaranga, Shubman Gill gets down on one knee to paddle this one behind square on the leg side but fails to get any bat on it. The ball hits him on the back leg and there is a loud shout by Hasaranga but gets turned down by the umpire. Sri Lanka send it upstairs but on UltraEdge there is a murmur as the ball is next to the glove. The onfield decision stands and Sri Lanka lose a review.
Short and turning in on middle, Shubman Gill defends this one back to the bowler.
Short and at the pads, Virat Kohli goes back and works it to deep square leg for a single.
Wanindu Hasaranga floats this one, full and on middle, Virat Kohli gets forward and flicks this one wide of long on. Jeffrey Vandersay dives to his right and keeps it to two.
On a length and outside off, Shubman Gill punches this one straight to backward point for a dot.
WIDE! Dasun Shanaka bowls this one tad full but down the leg side, Shubman Gill goes for the flick but fails to get any bat on it.
Fuller and on off, Virat Kohli uses his feet and pushes it to mid off for a single.
Back of a length on leg, Shubman Gill works this one in front of deep square leg. Wants the second but has to settle for a single.
FOUR! Full and around off, right where the batter wants it, Shubman Gill presses forward and drives this along the ground. Hits it right between extra cover and mid off for a boundary.
Back of a length outside off, Shubman Gill tries to work it on the off side but the ball keeps low and Gill under edges it towards the keeper.
Dasun Shanaka starts with a fullish delivery outside off, Shubman Gill uses his feet and drives it straight to cover.
On a length on middle, Shubman Gill pushes this one to the right of Wanindu Hasaranga at mid on and takes a quick single.
Good-length delivery on off, Shubman Gill clips it firmly but straight to mid-wicket.
Slower and touch short on middle, Virat Kohli lets the ball come to him and helps this one towards fine leg for a single.
Tad fuller and at the pads by Lahiru Kumara, Virat Kohli flicks it uppishly but to the left of deep square leg and that allows him to collect a couple of runs.
Back of a length and angling in on middle, Virat Kohli shuffles a bit and tries to defend this one but gets hit high on the pads.
WIDE! Lahiru Kumara loses his radar and sprays this one on a length but down the leg side, Virat Kohli looks to clip this one but misses. The umpire signals a wide.
Back of a length on leg, Shubman Gill gets inside and works this one to fine leg for a single.
Low full toss at the pads, Shubman Gill clips this one nicely towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Short and on off, Virat Kohli rocks back and cuts it along the ground to deep cover for a single.
Short and around off, the ball keeps a bit low but Shubman Gill still manages to pull this one towards mid-wicket for a single.
SIX! BANG! Jeffrey Vandersay floats this one, full around off, Shubman Gill gets down early and slogs this one towards the mid-wicket fence. Clears the ropes with ease and collects a maximum.
Flighted, fullish on off, Shubman Gill drives this on straight to cover.
Short and on middle by Jeffrey Vandersay, Virat Kohli goes back and works this one to deep square leg for a single.
Length and on the pads. Kohli nudges it to square leg for a single.
Another single! Lahiru Kumara goes short, on the body. It does not bounce much off the deck. Shubman Gill readjusts at the last moment and pulls it awkwardly to square leg for one.
A quick single now as Kohli eases this length ball towards mid on.
FOUR! Incredible shot! Too easy for Kohli though. Lahiru Kumara spills a length ball, down leg. Virat Kohli stays inside the crease and flicks it through square leg for four runs.
Quite short, outside off. Kohli reaches and dabs it to backward point.
A length ball, sliding down leg. Gill nudges it behind square on the leg side for one.
Shubman Gill charges down the track and strokes this full ball into the pocket at cover region. They take a single. FIFTY is up for Gill. He will eyeing to convert it into three digits here.
This full is driven through covers for one.
This is looped up, around middle. Turning away a hint with some bounce. Virat Kohli gets it to pop up off the top half of the blade.
A single now as this is driven to mid on.
Virat Kohli uses his feet and knocks this full ball down to long off for a single.
Full, outside off. Gill strokes it to mid off for a single.
On off, defended back to the bowler quite firmly. Just a couple off the over. There is also indication that there is some purchase off the deck now.
Length and outside off. Gill strokes it through covers for one.
Chamika Karunaratne now dishes a well-directed yorker, on middle. Gill has no shot to offer.
Chamika Karunaratne rolls his finger this time. It is a slower one, wide outside off. The ball stays low after hitting the deck. Gill tries to go after it but misses.
Virat Kohli stays back to this length ball and flicks it behind square on the leg side for a single.
A length ball, on top of off. Kohli defends it into the deck off the bottom half.

Time for Drinks! Having opted to bat first, India were off to a cautious start in the first five overs. Rohit Sharma and Shubman Gill then decided to take on Lahiru Kumara and that 23-run over allowed them to break free. Virat Kohli has looked good since his arrival and will look to carry forward the momentum. On the other hand, Sri Lanka will be relieved to see the back of Rohit Sharma and they must press on for more wickets.

Jeffrey Vandersay makes a sharp stop off his own bowling. It is full and on off. Gill drives it to the left of the bowler. Jeffrey Vandersay dives to that side, gets a hand on it and parries it to extra cover. An expensive over by Jeffrey Vandersay comes to an end.
Darted on the pads, Kohli clips it to short mid-wicket and gets to the other end in a flash.
FOUR! Back-to-back boundaries now! It is a short ball, outside off. Virat Kohli picks up the length early, rocks back and cuts it hard past point for a boundary.

FOUR! Wow! This is just too good. How on earth has Kohli found this narrow gap between extra cover and cover. It is full and outside off. Virat Kohli leans in and drives it through the gap for four runs.
Darted on the pads, Gill nudges it to the right of mid on and crosses.
Looped up, full and on leg. Kohli uses his feet and flicks it through mid-wicket for one.
Short and on off. Gill stands tall and flat-bats it to mid on.
Length, on off. Kohli pushes it out for one.

FOUR! Just exquisite! Virat Kohli gets off the mark with a boundary. Chamika Karunaratne goes full and on fourth stump. Virat Kohli opens the face and carves it past mid off. It races away to the fence.
Full length, just outside off. Virat Kohli presses forward and defends.
Virat Kohli walks in at number 3 for India.

OUT! CAUGHT! Oh no! The crowd has gone silent now as Rohit Sharma holes out against the run of play. It is quite short, on the bodyline. Rohit Sharma stays back and pulls it to deep square leg, although he does not get the desired connection on it and hits it straight down the throat of Fernando in the deep who makes no mistake. A huge wicket for Sri Lanka.
Commentary.Howout: c Avishka Fernando b Chamika Karunaratne

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR LEG BYES! It is full, sliding down leg. Sharma misses to flick it away. It brushes his pads and runs down to fine leg.
This is full, on sixth stump, at 87 clicks. Gill uses his feet and blocks it out towards point.
A full toss, on off. Sharma whips it to mid-wicket for a single.
Pushed through quicker, full and outside off. This one stays low. Rohit Sharma tries to have a waft at it but gets beaten on the inside edge.
Quite short, around off, turning away with some extra bounce. Rohit Sharma tries to cut it away late but misses.
On the pads, Gill nudges it to square leg and gets a single.
Full, attacking the stumps. Sharma drives it past extra cover for one.
Change of ends for Jeffrey Vandersay.
A dot to end the over! Length, on fourth stump. Gill defends it back to the bowler. A nice and tidy start for Chamika Karunaratne with the ball.
Full, straying on the pads, Rohit Sharma flicks it to the leg side and crosses.
Length, outside off. Rohit Sharma defends it out on his front foot.
It is full, swinging down leg, Gill stays back and flicks it to mid-wicket for one.
Length and on off. Gill defends it out watchfully.
Chamika Karunaratne starts with an inswinger, full and on off. Gill stays back and clips it to the leg side.
Chamika Karunaratne comes on to bowl, replacing Jeffrey Vandersay.
Just a single then! The spinners are doing well to restrict the run flow here. It is full, and on off, blocked out watchfully.
Goes full, attacking the pads. Sharma whips it hard but straight to short mid-wicket.
On off, blocked on the front foot.
A yorker-length delivery, in the blockhole. Rohit Sharma digs it out.
Wanindu Hasaranga serves it full and on leg, it dips as well. Rohit Sharma nudges it to the leg side.
Pitches it up, full and on off. Gill drives it to cover for one.
A single to end the over! Full, on off. Gill drives it to long off for a single.
Quite short, around off. Sharma goes back and knocks it down to long off for an easy single.
Short and on middle. Gill pulls it to deep mid-wicket for one.
Shortish, outside off. Gill goes back and cuts it through point for two runs.
Darted on the pads, Sharma flicks it to mid-wicket for one.
Flights it up, wide outside off. Rohit Sharma dabs it out. It is a loosener and could've been put away with ease.
Jeffrey Vandersay is introduced into the attack.
Darted on the pads, Gill tucks it to mid-wicket and collects a brace. A good over by Wanindu Hasaranga comes to an end. Just 4 runs come off it.
Flatter, on the pads, Shubman Gill goes back and nudges it to mid-wicket.
Around off, Gill gets on his front foot and pushes it to cover with soft hands.
Tosses it up, full and on middle. Gill pats it back to the bowler.
Full, attacking the stumps. Rohit Sharma pushes it to mid off and crosses.
Floats it up, full and on leg. Gill leans forward and knocks it down to long on for a single.
Powerplay 1 comes to an end. Now, 4 fielders can be placed outside the 30-yard circle until the end of the 40th over.

FOUR! Fuller and at the stumps, Rohit Sharma does not miss out and drives this one along the ground, gets it wide of mid on for a boundary. At the end of Powerplay 1, India have scored 75 runs without any loss of wicket.

SIX! STRAIGHT HIT! Kasun Rajitha serves this one full and around off, Rohit Sharma picks the length early and presents a full face of the bat. Lofts it over mid off and it goes all the way for a maximum.
SIX! DISPATCHED! Short and around off, Rohit Sharma picks the length early and pulls this one hard towards the mid-wicket fence. Clears the ropes and collects a maximum.
Length delivery on off, Rohit Sharma pushes this one uppishly back to the bowler, Kasun Rajitha gets hit on the toes and the ball almost lobs to the cover fielder.
On a length around off, Rohit Sharma punches this one firmly but straight to cover for a dot.
Back of a length on off, Rohit Sharma blocks this one out off the back foot.
FOUR! Fuller and at the stumps, Shubman Gill advances down the track and heaves across the line but gets it from the inner part of the bat and wide of mid on for a boundary.
Full and at the pads, Shubman Gill clips it straight to mid-wicket for a dot.

Floated, full and on middle, Rohit Sharma gets to the pitch of the delivery and flicks this one uppishly towards deep mid-wicket. Ashen Bandara at deep square leg sprints to his left and makes a good diving stop to save a run for his side.
Full and turning away on off, Rohit Sharma defends this one to cover for a dot.
Tossed up, full and on leg, Shubman Gill uses his feet to slog this one but miscues it towards deep square leg for a single.
Flighted, fuller on middle, Shubman Gill tries to defend but gets it from the inner part of the bat towards mid-wicket.
On a length on off, Rohit Sharma tries to drive it on the up but gets an inside edge. The ball sneaks past the leg stump and goes to the left of the keeper which allows the batters to run two.
Back of a length and angling in on pads, Rohit Sharma clips this one straight to short fine leg.
FOUR! Kasun Rajitha goes with the change of pace, bowls it slower and outside off, Rohit Sharma waits for it and frees his arms. Thumps this one over the bowler's head and collects a boundary.
On a length on off, Rohit Sharma pushes this one straight to mid on for a dot.
Fuller and outside off, Rohit Sharma drives this one firmly but fails to get it past mid off.
Back of a length around off by Kasun Rajitha, Rohit Sharma hangs back and punches this one along the ground to mid off for a dot.
Tossed up, full on off, Rohit Sharma drives this one to the left of the bowler and collects a single.
Full and outside off, Rohit Sharma drives this one off the front foot to cover for a dot.
Full and drifting in on middle, Rohit Sharma pushes this one back to the bowler.
Fuller on middle, Shubman Gill gets forward and knocks it down to long off for a single.
Short and turning away on off, Rohit Sharma punches this one off the back foot down to long off for a single.
Wanindu Hasaranga floats this one, fuller and on middle, Rohit Sharma defends this one back to the bowler.

FOUR! This is even better! Lahiru Kumara serves it full and outside off, Shubman Gill frees his arms and drives this one with a cross bat. It goes to the left of mid off for a boundary. An expensive over by Lahiru Kumara comes to an end.
FOUR! MAKE THAT THREE! Lahiru Kumara misses his length and bowls a low full toss at the pads, Shubman Gill does not miss out and clips this one nicely through mid-wicket for another boundary.

FOUR! TWO IN TWO! Lahiru Kumara changes his length and bowls it touch fuller around off, Shubman Gill gets forward and drives this one along the ground. Gets it between mid off and extra cover for a boundary.
FOUR! Back of a length outside off, Shubman Gill stays inside the line and punches this one nicely through the covers region and collects a boundary.

Short of a length outside off, Rohit Sharma punches this one along the ground towards cover and rushes for a single. Nuwanidu Fernando at cover collects it cleanly and fires in a throw at the non-striker's end but does not hit. The replays show that Rohit Sharma would have been in trouble had Fernando hit.

SIX! SHOT! Lahiru Kumara serves this one full and at the pads of the batter, Rohit Sharma picks the length early and flicks this one off the front foot. Gets plenty of bat on it and it goes all the way towards the square leg fence for a maximum.
Fuller and at the stumps, Shubman Gill drives this one firmly but straight to mid on.
On a length outside off, Shubman Gill pushes this one off the front foot towards mid off for a dot.
FOUR! Nicely played! Fuller and in the channel outside off, Shubman Gill plants his foot forward and goes through with the drive. Times this one well and hits it past extra cover for a boundary.
Good-length delivery on off, Shubman Gill drives this one firmly towards mid off for a dot.

FOUR! Kasun Rajitha loses his radar and bowls this one full and down the leg side, Shubman Gill uses his feet and flicks this one towards fine leg. The ball was travelling and Lahiru Kumara at fine leg fails to get down in time and concedes a boundary.
Tad fuller on off by Kasun Rajitha, Shubman Gill drives this one on the up towards cover but Avishka Fernando at cover dives to his left and makes a good stop.
Back of a length outside off, the ball stops in the surface a bit, Rohit Sharma fends this one uppishly towards mid-wicket for a dot.
Good-length delivery around off, Rohit Sharma blocks this one out to the bowler.
Touch fuller on middle, Shubman Gill pushes this one towards mid on and sets off for a quick single. Wanindu Hasaranga at mid on makes a good stop to his left and keeps it to one.
Back of a length on off, Shubman Gill punches this one straight to cover for a dot.
FOUR! Short and punished! Short and outside off by Lahiru Kumara, Shubman Gill stands tall and cuts this one hard along the carpet. Gets it through the gap and opens his account with a boundary.
On a length on middle and straightens after pitching, Rohit Sharma looks to work it on the leg side but closes the bat face early. Gets an outside edge that rolls to third man for a single.
Kasun Rajitha persists with back of a length stuff, bowls this one on middle, Shubman Gill knocks this one towards mid on for a dot.
Back of a length on off, Shubman Gill tries to punch this one on the off side but mishits it towards mid-wicket.
Fuller and on middle, Shubman Gill drives this one straight to mid on for no run.
Back of a length and angling in on middle, Shubman Gill pushes this one towards mid on for a dot.
On a length and at the pads, Rohit Sharma clips this one off his hips towards fine leg for a single. First runs of the bat for India.
Fuller and outside off, Rohit Sharma gets forward and defends it to cover.
Full and outside off, Shubman Gill looks to defend this one but miscues it towards mid on for a dot.
Length delivery on middle, Shubman Gill clips this one straight to mid-wicket for a dot. A fumble by the fielder there but batters decide not to run
Good-length delivery angling in on middle, Shubman Gill looks to defend but gets hit on the pads but the replays show that Shubman Gill had gotten an inside edge on it.
Back of a length on off, Shubman Gill defends this one to cover for no run.
Four Leg byes! Fuller and drifting at the pads, Shubman Gill looks to flick this one but fails to get any bat on it. The ball comes off his pads and rolls towards the fine leg fence for a boundary.
Lahiru Kumara bowls this one on a length around off, jags back in and Shubman Gill accounts for the swing and lets it go.
Lahiru Kumara to share the new ball.

Back of a length on middle, nips back into the batter, Rohit Sharma hangs back to defend but gets beaten on the inside edge. A loud shout by the bowler as the ball hits Rohit on the pads but the umpire is unmoved. Kasun Rajitha starts with a maiden.
Beaten! Kasun Rajitha serves this one on a length outside off, Rohit Sharma pokes at the delivery but misses .
Good-length delivery on off, Rohit Sharma gets behind and blocks this one out to cover for a dot.
Back of a length outside off, shaping away, Rohit Sharma tries to defend this one but gets beaten on the outside edge.
On a length on middle, Rohit Sharma clips this one off the back foot towards square leg for a dot.
Kasun Rajitha starts with a back-of-a-length delivery, a hint of away movement, Rohit Sharma shoulders arms and leaves it alone.
The match is set to begin. Sri Lanka players stride out to the middle. Followed by Rohit Sharma and Shubman Gill who walk out to open for India. It will be Kasun Rajitha to start with the new ball.

Shreyas Iyer is in for a quick chat. He says that he tries to score runs on every ball and put pressure on the bowler. Adds that by doing so he wants momentum on his side. Feels that it is important in the ODI format to get off to a good start. Shares that he looks to maintain rhythm and not complicate things. Mentions he loves to live in the moment and try to grab any opportunity that comes his way. Adds he likes to stick to his routines and ends by saying the outside noise does not have any effect on him.

Dasun Shanaka, the skipper of Sri Lanka, says that he would have batted first as well. Adds that he expects spin assistance in later part of the game. Shares that this part of the world feels like home. Feels that in India it is important to score big runs. Also says that they have not had hundred in this series and he expects batters to capitalize on the start. Ends by informing that there are two changes in the side. Ashen Bandara comes in for Dhananjaya de Silva and Dunith Wellalage makes way for Jeffrey Vandersay.

Rohit Sharma the captain of India starts by saying that they will try to put on as many runs as possible. Adds they have an opportunity here to rectify their mistakes. Ends by saying there are two changes to the side Washington Sundar and Suryakumar Yadav comes in for Hardik Pandya and Umran Malik.

Sri Lanka (Playing XI) - Avishka Fernando, Kusal Mendis (WK), Nuwanidu Fernando, Charith Asalanka, Ashen Bandara (In for Dhananjaya de Silva), Dasun Shanaka (C), Wanindu Hasaranga, Jeffrey Vandersay (In for Dunith Wellalage), Chamika Karunaratne, Kasun Rajitha, Lahiru Kumara.

India (Playing XI) - Rohit Sharma (C), Shubman Gill, Virat Kohli, Shreyas Iyer, KL Rahul (WK), Suryakumar Yadav (In for Hardik Pandya), Axar Patel, Washington Sundar (In for Umran Malik), Mohammad Shami, Mohammed Siraj, Kuldeep Yadav.
TOSS - The coin goes up and lands in favour of India. They will BAT first.

PITCH REPORT - Kumar Sangakkara is near the deck. He says that the deck looks really good. There is no grass on it but there are some cracks on offer. Adds that he expects Sri Lanka to win the toss and chase to get the dew factor in play today.

Having now lost both the T20I and ODI series, Sri Lanka will look to end their tour of India on a winning note. The visitors are yet to put in a complete performance in this white-ball tour, and their fans will be hoping that their side can get the win in this game. Will the visitors manage to avoid a whitewash? Or will it be India that prove too strong once again? We shall find out soon, as the toss isn't far away.

India have started the World Cup year on the right note by winning the series, and they will look to make it 3-0. Having already sealed the series, the hosts would want to rest a few players and provide playing time to the likes of Ishan Kishan, Suryakumar Yadav and Arshdeep Singh.

Hello and a warm welcome, ladies and gentlemen, to our coverage of the 3rd ODI between India and Sri Lanka at the Greenfield International Stadium in Thiruvananthapuram. With India having already taken an unassailable 2-0 lead in the series, the third ODI would have been a dead rubber in a non-World Cup year, but with the ODI World Cup scheduled to be played later in the year, both teams would want to make full use of whatever game time they are getting.
... MATCH DAY ...

It is now time for the third and the final ODI match between India and Sri Lanka. This is the final match of the series. First, India won the T20I series which was decided in the final match, although in the 50-over format, India have managed to take an unassaible lead coming into the final game. India were quite solid with the ball in the previous outing and restricted Sri Lanka to a below par score. Although, they put themselves under pressure by losing at regular intervals but KL Rahul rose to the occasion and managed to take his side over the line with his fine unbeaten knock of 64 runs. India might make some tweaks to the side as they have already sealed the series, they might give some opportunity to the players who have remained on the sideline. Sri Lanka, on the other hand, did put up a solid fight on both the occasions in this ODI series but fell short every single time. Their batters need to focus on building stands in the middle. Some batters are getting off to great starts but are unable to make their innings count. The Sri Lankan bowlers though would hope to restrict the run flow the middle overs. Sri Lanka would come into this game with all guns blazing. Will they be able to go back home with a win in their kitty? Or will India complete the white wash? We shall find out together.
